integrity: Proof is analytical. The exact-rational finite enumerations independently corroborate but do not establish the universal quantifiers. Relevant literature comparisons were performed but unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple unit-edge lollipop graphs formed by a clique of order at least three and a path of at least three new edges; uniform vertex mass, real quadratic variance only. No generalization to weighted or multiple tails is proved.
title: Sharp Lipschitz spread and a quadratic clique–tail transition on lollipop graphs
